steps.warmUp: Start with the warm-up, as in every singing lesson: a few easy minutes to wake up your voice.
steps.fourthFifth: Bigger leaps: from do up to fa is a fourth, and up to sol a fifth. Aim for the top note: hear it first, then go right to it. Leaping down, keep the low note light and don’t drop your chin.
steps.doFaSol: Do up to fa, then up to sol, back to do each time. The music waits at each note.
steps.solDo: Leaps down: listen, then sing it in time, from sol down to do and from fa down to do.
steps.leapsAlong: A fifth up, then steps back down, singing along with the guide melody.
